day_shape: 56 items: Hebron shooting attack triggers IDF West Bank cordon, Brent crude tops $116, Jpost reports Iranian plans to target Gulf undersea cables, Turkish FM warns against renewed strikes, heavy Khamenei/IRIB Fatimiyya mourning cycle.

threads.label: Hebron attack and IDF West Bank cordon
threads.summary: The IDF said counterterrorism operations were launched in Hebron after a shooting attack wounded five, with Netanyahu ordering the city cordoned off and the West Bank closed to travel. Defa Press and Hezbollah posted statements praising the attackers, named as Hammoudeh and Firas al-Ja'abah.

threads.label: US-Iran standoff and renewed strike signals
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported senior Iranian security officials saying Iran had drawn up plans to target undersea Gulf internet cables if the US and Israel resume strikes, while Turkish FM Hakan Fidan warned renewed strikes would expand the regional war. Iran International cited US UN Ambassador Mike Waltz saying Washington can maintain its Iranian ports blockade "for the foreseeable future" as Trump weighs post-midterm strikes.

threads.label: Oil prices and Iran export collapse
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported Brent crude passing $116 per barrel, the highest since 19 March. Iran International reported Chinese imports of Iranian oil relabelled as Malaysian had collapsed under the US naval blockade, with Iran's evasion network intact but running out of crude to feed it.

threads.label: Iranian regime defiance and mobilisation messaging
threads.summary: Tehran mayor Zakan, armed forces spokesman Akraminia, Supreme Leader adviser Mokhber and Majles speaker Qalibaf posted statements framing Trump and Netanyahu threats as desperation and asserting Iranian military readiness. Khamenei's office and IRIB ran a heavy Fatimiyya mourning and Nurses' Day cycle, including a message marking 24 Mehr 1405.

threads.label: Iran domestic security posture and influence operations
threads.summary: Iran International reported increased armed patrols, checkpoints and degraded internet access across Iran, and said state-linked hackers used US-hosted infrastructure to target dissidents per Semperis. A separate Iran International report cited the Guardian saying a Reform UK billionaire donor previously had a business venture with Khamenei-linked foundation Astan Quds Razavi.

events.title_en: Is mobile phone use permitted in schools? Mousa Reza Kafash, deputy secretary-general of the Supreme Council of Education: educational use of mobile phones in the classroom for specific activities and in line with the curriculum is permitted with the teacher's approval and at specified and limited times. The decision regarding bringing a mobile phone to school, where it is stored, the time and area permitted for its use, and sanctions for violating regulations is the responsibility of the school council. Installing CCTV cameras is also permitted in public areas of schools whilst preserving the privacy of staff and students; in schools with disciplinary problems, the temporary installation of cameras in classrooms is possible with the school council's approval.

events.title_en: The finest act of proxy. Published on the occasion of the martyrdom of Hazrat Zahra (peace be upon her). A personal account: someone visited Imam Jawad (peace be upon him) and said that whenever I am honoured to perform the Hajj or Umrah, I perform a circumambulation on behalf of the Prophet, and on behalf of Commander of the Faithful, continuing in this manner until reaching the Imam himself, and said that on behalf of your mother Hazrat Zahra (peace be upon her) I perform the same deed. They said that the deed performed by proxy on behalf of the Pure Truthful Lady (peace and blessings of God be upon her) is higher than all of these. The Conduct of Servitude collection comprises spiritual and ethical points derived from the lessons of Ayatollah Seyyed Khamenei, which shall be published progressively by the Supreme Leader's media office.

events.title_en: Hezbollah's congratulatory message on the occasion of the anti-Zionist Hebron operation
events.summary_en: Hezbollah congratulations message on the occasion of the anti-Zionist Hebron operation. Hezbollah of Lebanon stressed that efforts to force the Palestinian people to surrender and break their will shall fail in the face of this nation's steadfastness and commitment to their rights, land and holy sites. Hezbollah of Lebanon, in its statement, congratulated the operation carried out by 'Hammoudeh al-Ja'abah' and 'Firas al-Ja'abah' at the 'Farsh al-Hawa' checkpoint in the city of Hebron and added: the continued settlement building, demolition and levelling operations in the West Bank and Jerusalem, and the killing, destruction and violations of Palestinian rights and their holy sites that accompany it, worsen the situation and threaten Palestinian existence in their land.

events.title_en: Mokhber: Knowing the enemy's weaknesses; tactical surprise and the oil and energy lever have driven the enemy to desperation
events.summary_en: Mokhber: Knowing the enemy's weaknesses; tactical surprise and the oil and energy lever have driven the enemy to desperation. Dr Mohammad Mokhber, adviser and assistant to the Supreme Leader, in view of the recent threats from Trump and Netanyahu, which stem mainly from their frustration at Iran's military capabilities and its influence on global energy prices, wrote on his personal page: Psychological warfare and the threats of Trump and Netanyahu smell more of desperation than power. Iran knows the enemy's weak points and tactical surprises and the oil and energy lever can overturn the equations. In this region there remains a nation that has dwelt there for thousands of years, and the Zionist regime can only contemplate its own non-existence.

events.title_en: Martyrdom of 351 children since the announcement of the ceasefire in Gaza in October 2025
events.summary_en: Martyrdom of 351 children since the announcement of the ceasefire in Gaza in October 2025. The UN Children's Fund announced that since the announcement of the ceasefire in October 2025, 351 children in the Gaza Strip have been martyred. Edward Begbeder, regional director of UNICEF for the Middle East and North Africa, in a statement called on the Zionist regime officials to ensure transparent and serious accountability regarding incidents of children being killed or injured, which has led to their permanent disability. He announced that in the past six days alone, eight children have been martyred and 20 other children wounded. He also called for effective measures to prevent the continuation of violence, respect for the principle of distinction and guarantee of special support for affected children.

events.summary_en: Praise from Abu Ubaida for the anti-Zionist Hebron operation. The spokesman for the Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades, whilst congratulating the martyrdom operation in Hebron, called on the Palestinian people to rise up in defence of Al-Aqsa Mosque and Palestinian prisoners and in response to the aggression of the Zionist regime. The spokesman for the Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades also called for support for the people of Gaza who, he said, do not accept injustice and surrender. In the anti-Zionist operation this morning in Hebron in the West Bank, two Zionist soldiers were killed and four soldiers were wounded.

events.summary_en: Zakan: We will not allow our will to be imposed upon Iran. The mayor of Tehran, emphasising Iran's military capability, said: the other side cannot impose its will on the country. We are well-equipped in the military sphere to overcome these circumstances; such that for any blow they inflict, they will receive a stronger blow in return. events.title_en: Emphasis by the Commander of the Ground Forces on comprehensive readiness and resolute resistance against enemy threats
events.summary_en: Emphasis by the Commander of the Ground Forces on comprehensive readiness and resolute resistance against enemy threats. In pursuance of safeguarding the security and authority of Islamic Iran and strengthening defensive readiness against enemy threats, the Commander of the Ground Forces emphasised the need to maintain combat readiness, constant vigilance, strengthening the spirit of sacrifice and resistance, and enhancing the operational capability of units. He, referring to the nature of the enemy's combined and heterogeneous threats, added: the enemy, alongside military threats, seeks to create doubt, weaken morale and disrupt the cohesion of the armed forces. Effective confrontation of these threats requires comprehensive vigilance, continuous operational readiness and possessing the capability for swift and effective response.

events.title_en: Amir Akraminia: We have not seen more criminal leaders than America's in history
events.summary_en: Amir Akraminia: We have not seen more criminal leaders than America's in history. The spokesman for the armed forces, noting that America, whilst negotiating, with utmost brutality, killed a group of our innocent people, wrote: We have not seen such criminals from ancient times until now. We are also facing a country that, whilst negotiating, with utmost brutality, in one moment killed 168 children and a number of athletes with banned bombs, 104 sailors in a foreign country and a wedding in the same country that they were facing. Have you seen such criminals from ancient times until now?

events.title: US signals prolonged Iran standoff as Trump weighs new strikes
events.summary: The United States is prepared for a prolonged confrontation with Iran and can maintain its blockade on Iranian ports “for the foreseeable future,” US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz said, as President Donald Trump weighs whether to resume major strikes after midterm elections.

events.title: Iranian state-linked hackers used US server to target dissidents, researchers say
events.summary: An Iranian state-sponsored hacking group used command-and-control infrastructure hosted in the United States this year after a months-long pause in operations, according to cybersecurity firm Semperis.

events.title: ⭕️ Following the shooting attack earlier today, IDF soldiers and Israel Border Police officers launched offensive counterterrorism operations in the Hebron area, which has been placed under a cordon, and in additional areas. Over the past week, security forces apprehended ~70 wanted individuals, including Hamas and Islamic Jihad affiliates, and located dozens of weapons, including M16 rifles, Carlo submachine guns & explosive devices. The IDF will continue conducting offensive counterterrorism operations to safeguard Israeli civilians.
